textos.Os relatos convergem ao centrar a discus: The accounts converge in centering the discussion on parallels with other works, diverging on their effectiveness. Most of those who recommend the film consider that these relationships enhance the experience, while about half of those who do not recommend it judge that these comparative references do not work.
textos.A maioria dos críticos deste grupo acha: Most of the critics in this group think the songs interrupt the film's pace and do not fit the character's premise, making the experience tiring and senseless.
textos.Várias pessoas apontam que a história qu: Several people point out that the story barely moves forward, that there is no character development and that the film feels empty, relying on repetition and returns to the past.
textos.Muitos fãs do longa original sentem que: Many fans of the original film feel that the protagonist lost the complexity and essence that made him interesting, turning into someone unrecognizable and without depth.
textos.Várias pessoas dizem que o filme se arra: Several people say the film drags, with long, static scenes that do not hold attention, leading to boredom and even to walking out of the theater before the end.
textos.Parte do público reclama que a personage: A portion of the audience complains that Lady Gaga's character gets little prominence in the plot, serving more as an ornament than as someone of real importance to the story.
textos.Alguns espectadores ficaram decepcionado: Some viewers were disappointed with the ending, considering it without impact and incompatible with the grandeur expected for the character.
textos.A inclusão de números musicais foi vista: The inclusion of musical numbers was seen as unnecessary and disconnected, not contributing to the advancement of the plot or to character development, only dragging the pace.
textos.Este grupo considera que a sequência não: This group considers that the sequel does not reach the narrative strength and impact of the original film, seeming inferior in several respects.
textos.As performances de Joaquin Phoenix e Lad: The performances of Joaquin Phoenix and Lady Gaga were highlighted as a high point, with good chemistry between them, although some found Harley Quinn's role underused.
textos.A direção de arte e a fotografia foram a: The art direction and cinematography were described as visually beautiful, with a striking atmosphere and well-composed scenes, contributing to the aesthetic experience.
textos.A trama foi considerada arrastada, com d: The plot was considered dragging, with insufficient development and a certain lack of focus, which compromised engagement and the ending.
textos.Parte do grupo percebeu uma tentativa de: A portion of the group perceived an attempt to demystify the protagonist, showing his fragile humanity and moving away from the iconic image of the clown, which generated mixed reactions.
textos.Uso do musical como expressão da mente: Use of the musical as an expression of the mind
textos.As reviews positivas veem os números mus: The positive reviews see the musical numbers as a creative way to translate Arthur's distorted reality and his escape into fantasy, even acknowledging that the choice may not please everyone.
textos.Crítica à idolatria do Coringa: Critique of the idolatry of the Joker
textos.Este grupo de reviews positivas entende: This group of positive reviews understands the film as a deliberate provocation to the fans who deified the Joker persona, showing that Arthur Fleck is not a hero, but a sick man whom his own creation consumes.
textos.O grupo elogia especialmente Joaquin Pho: The group especially praises Joaquin Phoenix, who sustains the character's complexity, and Lady Gaga, whose interpretation of Harley Quinn escapes the submissive stereotype, bringing an energy of her own.
textos.As reviews positivas valorizam a decisão: The positive reviews value the decision not to repeat the first film's formula, preferring a bold, risky path that deconstructs expectations and bets on innovation.
textos.Este grupo destaca a beleza visual do fi: This group highlights the film's visual beauty, with gothic, dark cinematography that maintains Gotham's characteristic atmosphere, as well as intentional lighting compositions.
textos.As reviews positivas consideram o desfec: The positive reviews consider the ending a powerful conclusion to Arthur's trajectory, since it reveals the distance between the real person and the symbol he inspired.

While dealing with the conflict of his dual identity, the protagonist comes face to face with true love and finds the music that was always within him.
